title: Cyber Resilience Act for products with digital elements
description: Proposed for software publishers: keep it when the organization places on the EU market a product with digital elements, software or hardware with its remote data processing solutions (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847, Art. 3(1) and 3(2)). A SaaS that is not the remote data processing of such a product falls outside the CRA: recital 12 points cloud services such as SaaS to NIS 2.
